resources.string: Optional. Lets the masker resist being silently force-stopped or uninstalled. It requests no password, wipe, or login-monitoring powers.
Enabling this only protects the masker from being stopped or removed without your say-so. It does not grant password, wipe, or login-monitoring powers.
Turning this off lets any app or tap force-stop or uninstall the masker again.
Detect apps drawing on top of this one (tapjacking)

Optional. Reports when another app draws a window over this one — the setup used to harvest taps you believe you are giving this app. It reads window position and size only: it never reads screen content, never sees what you type, and never blocks a touch. Findings go to the encrypted log.
